company.name: Al Jouf Cement
company.shortDescription: Al Jouf Cement is a concrete company that provides reinforced concrete.
company.description: Al Jouf Cement produces regular cement and cement resistant to sulfates. To meet the needs of its clients, the business is connected to a network of transportation providers. Its product portfolio consists of pozzolanic cement, ordinary cement, and cement resistant to sulphate salts.
